name: tempo
description: Tempo: a task app, built by the agent pipeline in .github/.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @tempo/api" "npm run dev -w @tempo/web"
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.lint: eslint --config .github/lint/eslint.config.js --max-warnings 0 apps packages && prettier --config .github/lint/prettier.json --check apps packages
scripts.format: prettier --config .github/lint/prettier.json --write apps packages && eslint --config .github/lint/eslint.config.js --fix apps packages
